Action.description: What a client may do with one open decision.
Action.title: Action

ActivityEntry.description: One `log.md` bullet: its section date and its text.
ActivityEntry.title: ActivityEntry

Answer.description:
What an ask returns, already gated: no field names, titles or quotes a
concept outside the disclosable set; `withheld` counts them.
Answer.title: Answer

AnswerCitation.description: A concept the answer drew on.
AnswerCitation.title: AnswerCitation

Applied.description:
The action took effect. `commit_sha` is `None` when the auto-commit
degraded (the write itself still landed). `committed_confidential` is true
only when a commit landed and holds a concept explicitly marked
`sensitivity: confidential`; an adapter that has no notice of its own to
print leaves it false, and one that reports it sets it from the commit's
outcome.
Applied.title: Applied

ApplyRequest.description:
The action, the version the preview issued (echoed unchanged) and how
long to wait for the workspace lock; a client can shorten the wait only.
ApplyRequest.title: ApplyRequest

ApplyResponse.description:
What was applied, and the warnings the apply raised along the way (for
example a commit that could not be made).
ApplyResponse.title: ApplyResponse

AskJob.description:
An ask as a poll sees it. The answer is `openkos.api.ask`'s own, already
gated; a failure is a field here, never the poll's HTTP status. A response
model only: no `extra="forbid"`, which would reach the nested dataclasses.
AskJob.title: AskJob

AskRequest.description: A question to ask. An omitted `limit` is the API's default.
AskRequest.title: AskRequest

ContradictionDetail.description:
A contradiction: two pages that say incompatible things. A merged-body
one (`merged_absorbed_id` set) was found inside a combined page, between
the page and the one it absorbed.
ContradictionDetail.title: ContradictionDetail

Decision.description: One open decision, as data a client can render.
Decision.title: Decision

DecisionList.description: Every open decision, in an envelope that leaves room for additive fields.
DecisionList.title: DecisionList

DecisionPreview.description:
`api.DecisionPreview` with its plan declared as a discriminated union. The
field names are `openkos.api`'s own. A response model only: no
`extra="forbid"`, which would reach the nested dataclasses and split their
components into `-Input` and `-Output` variants.
DecisionPreview.title: DecisionPreview

DecisionVersion.description:
The version a stateless caller commits against.

`payload_digest` proves the queue row, its proposal and its recorded
inputs are unchanged; `content_digest` proves the bytes the human saw are
the bytes that would be written. `payload_digest` is `None` when no queue
row backs the item, which the token path rejects. `decision_key` is the
handle: a findings row id is never used, because the cache is derived.
DecisionVersion.title: DecisionVersion

DeclinePlan.description: Recording that a contradiction was looked at and left as it is.
DeclinePlan.title: DeclinePlan

ErrorBody.description: The one body shape of every non-2xx response.
ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

FindingPlan.description:
The plan of a finding preview, a union discriminated on `kind`, kept apart
from `PreviewPlan` so the decision preview's union does not change (ADR-0072).
Defaulted fields are marked required in the response, as for `PreviewPlan`.
FindingPlan.title: FindingPlan

FindingPreview.description:
`api.FindingPreview` with its plan declared as a discriminated union. A
response model only, like `DecisionPreview`.
FindingPreview.title: FindingPreview

FindingPreviewRequest.description:
Which contradiction or revision action to preview for the decision named
in the path.
FindingPreviewRequest.title: FindingPreviewRequest

GroupSelection.description:
The members a person marked the same, and the one that stays.

`member_ids` are the marked members, the survivor included. A selection
is data the caller supplies to a `merge_group` preview and is carried in
the `DecisionVersion` it returns, so an altered selection is a stale
version. It is canonicalised (deduplicated, ascending) by
`validate_selection` before it enters a version.
GroupSelection.title: GroupSelection

HealthCounts.description:
How many findings each knowledge-health check reports. Counts only; the
findings themselves are not part of the surface.
HealthCounts.title: HealthCounts

IdentityDetail.description: An identity decision: a group that may be one entity.
IdentityDetail.title: IdentityDetail

IngestBinding.description: What consent was given to, beside the files. A change is stale.
IngestBinding.title: IngestBinding

IngestJob.description:
An ingest run as a poll sees it. The run's own result is a field here,
never the poll's HTTP status. A response model only: no `extra="forbid"`,
which would reach the nested dataclasses.
IngestJob.title: IngestJob

IngestQuote.description: What adding the chosen files would cost, and the token to run it.
IngestQuote.title: IngestQuote

IngestQuoteRequest.description:
The files to price, by absolute path, and whether the run may send text
above the workspace's floor. Every path check is the API's.
IngestQuoteRequest.title: IngestQuoteRequest

IngestQuoteToken.description: The context consent was given for. Refused files are not in it.
IngestQuoteToken.title: IngestQuoteToken

IngestRunRequest.description:
The ingest quote's token, echoed unchanged. A missing or null token is a
refusal the route answers (422 `run_refused`), not a validation error.
IngestRunRequest.title: IngestRunRequest

IngestTokenFile.description:
One file the consent covers: its path, its bytes' sha256 and the most
calls it may spend.
IngestTokenFile.title: IngestTokenFile

JudgingOutcomeBody.description: What a judging run returned, field for field, with a failure as a body.
JudgingOutcomeBody.title: JudgingOutcomeBody

KeepDistinctPlan.description: Recording that these concepts are different things.
KeepDistinctPlan.title: KeepDistinctPlan

KeptDistinct.description: Pages a person said are different things, and when.
KeptDistinct.title: KeptDistinct

KeptDistinctList.description:
Every member set kept distinct, newest first, in an envelope that leaves
room for additive fields.
KeptDistinctList.title: KeptDistinctList

KindCounts.description: Lifetime counters of one pending-work kind.
KindCounts.title: KindCounts

KindRefresh.description: What one refresh did for one kind of decision.
KindRefresh.title: KindRefresh

MemoryReadiness.description:
The machine's physical memory against ADR-0047's floor. `total_bytes`
and `meets_floor` are `None` where the memory cannot be read.
MemoryReadiness.title: MemoryReadiness

MergeHistory.description:
What was merged into a concept, newest first, in an envelope that leaves
room for additive fields.
MergeHistory.title: MergeHistory

MergePlan.description:
Merging concepts into a survivor: one pairwise merge, or, for
`merge_group`, one per marked member.
MergePlan.title: MergePlan

MergeRecord.description: One merge recorded on a concept: `survivor_id` absorbed `absorbed_id`.
MergeRecord.title: MergeRecord

MergeStep.description: One pairwise merge of a plan: `survivor_id` absorbs `absorbed_id`.
MergeStep.title: MergeStep

MergedConcept.description: A page that has absorbed others, with what was merged into it.
MergedConcept.title: MergedConcept

MergedConceptList.description:
Every combined page, newest combine first, in an envelope that leaves
room for additive fields.
MergedConceptList.title: MergedConceptList

ModelReadiness.description:
One configured model tag.

`roles` names what the tag is for (`chat`, `embedding`, or task names).
`required` is true for the chat and embedding models, which ingest and ask
need; a task model fails only the stage that names it. `installed` is
`None` when the runtime's model list could not be read. `pullable` is true
where setup can pull it (the `ollama` backend).
ModelReadiness.title: ModelReadiness

ModelSettings.description:
The workspace's model setup.

`base_url` and `embedding_base_url` are what `openkos.yaml` says (`None`
when unset). `remote_hosts` is the redacted display host of each resolved
endpoint that is not on this machine, the chat endpoint first; `is_local`
is true exactly when it is empty. `takes_api_key` is true for the
`openai-compatible` backend, whose key the engine reads only from
`OPENKOS_OPENAI_API_KEY`; nothing here ever carries a key.
ModelSettings.title: ModelSettings

ModelSettingsApplyRequest.description:
The version the settings preview issued (echoed unchanged) and how long
to wait for the workspace lock; a client can shorten the wait only.
ModelSettingsApplyRequest.title: ModelSettingsApplyRequest

ModelSettingsChange.description:
The model setup asked for. A `None` URL removes its line, so the
backend's own default applies (`ollama` only: `openai-compatible` needs a
`base_url`).
ModelSettingsChange.title: ModelSettingsChange

ModelSettingsChanged.description:
The settings were written. `commit_sha` is `None` when the commit could
not be made (the write itself landed).
ModelSettingsChanged.title: ModelSettingsChanged

ModelSettingsPreview.description:
What the change would do. `changes` lists every field that differs, in
the order of `ModelSettingsChange`. `search_rebuild` is true when the
embedding identity changes, so the stored vectors no longer match and
search needs rebuilding.
ModelSettingsPreview.title: ModelSettingsPreview

ModelSettingsPreviewRequest.description:
The model setup asked for. A `null` URL removes its line, so the
backend's own default applies. There is no field for a key: the engine
reads a key only from its environment, which the desktop shell sets.
ModelSettingsPreviewRequest.title: ModelSettingsPreviewRequest

ModelSettingsResponse.description: What was written, and the warnings the apply raised along the way.
ModelSettingsResponse.title: ModelSettingsResponse

ModelSettingsVersion.description:
The version a stateless caller applies a change against: echo it
unchanged. `change` is the normalized request; `content_digest` covers it
and the bytes of `openkos.yaml`.
ModelSettingsVersion.title: ModelSettingsVersion

OmittedConcept.description: A retrieved concept the context budget left out of the prompt entirely.
OmittedConcept.title: OmittedConcept

Page.description: One page as the desktop app shows it.
Page.title: Page

PageSource.description: A file the person added that a page came from.
PageSource.title: PageSource

PendingRow.description: One open pending-work row and the command that resolves it.
PendingRow.title: PendingRow

PreviewPlan.description:
The plan of a preview, declared as a discriminated union.

The plan types carry a literal `kind`, so the OpenAPI document names it as the
discriminator and a generated client narrows `plan` with `switch (plan.kind)`.
The plan types are `openkos.api`'s own, and the wrapper serialises as the bare
plan. A defaulted `kind` is always sent, so the response schema marks it (and
every other defaulted plan field) required. That flag lives HERE and not on
`DecisionPreview`, because it reaches every nested dataclass: on the preview it
would also mark `DecisionVersion.selection` required in the response only, and
`DecisionVersion`, which a client echoes back in a request, would split into
`-Input` and `-Output` components.
PreviewPlan.title: PreviewPlan

PreviewRequest.description:
Which action to preview for the decision named in the path, and, for
`merge_group` only, the members the person marked and the survivor.

A request model that carries a nested API dataclass, so it rejects unknown
top-level keys itself (see `_EchoRequest`) rather than through `extra="forbid"`,
which would split `GroupSelection` into `-Input` and `-Output` components.
PreviewRequest.title: PreviewRequest

PullOutcome.description:
How a pull ended: `completed`, `already_installed` (no pull was made) or
`stopped`, with the bytes reported by then.
PullOutcome.title: PullOutcome

PullRequest.description: Start a pull of one configured model tag.
PullRequest.title: PullRequest

PullStatus.description:
A model pull as a poll sees it. The pull's own result is a field here,
never the poll's HTTP status.
PullStatus.title: PullStatus

QueueRefresh.description: The three per-kind results of one refresh.
QueueRefresh.title: QueueRefresh

QuoteBinding.description: What consent was given to. A change of any field is `QuoteStale`.
QuoteBinding.title: QuoteBinding

QuoteRequest.description:
Which judging to price, and whether the quote may include what the run
needs consent for.
QuoteRequest.title: QuoteRequest

QuoteToken.description:
The context consent was given for. It holds no time: a token is stale
only when a binding field moved, decided by resolved values and digests.
QuoteToken.title: QuoteToken

ReconcilePlan.description:
Recording how two pages relate, as `reconcile` writes it: both stand
(`reconciled_with`, no holder), one replaces the other (`supersedes`, the
target listed as deprecated), or one refines the other (`revises`, both
stay current).
ReconcilePlan.title: ReconcilePlan

RefreshRequest.description: How long a queue refresh waits for the workspace lock.
RefreshRequest.title: RefreshRequest

RefusedFileDetail.description:
A file the inbox watch did not add: `file_name` is its path relative to
the inbox. `changed_after_import`: a file of that name was already added
with different contents. `exceeds_pass_budget`: it is larger than one
unattended pass may add.
RefusedFileDetail.title: RefusedFileDetail

RefusedFileQuoteRequest.description:
Whether the run of a refused file's quote may send text above the
workspace's floor.
RefusedFileQuoteRequest.title: RefusedFileQuoteRequest

RelatePlan.description: Writing one typed relation, as it would be written.
RelatePlan.title: RelatePlan

RelationDetail.description: A relation-type decision: a suggested type for one untyped edge.
RelationDetail.title: RelationDetail

ReopenApplyRequest.description:
The version the reopen preview issued (echoed unchanged) and how long to
wait for the workspace lock; a client can shorten the wait only.
ReopenApplyRequest.title: ReopenApplyRequest

ReopenPreview.description:
Reopening the ruling over `member_ids`: they may be offered as the same
thing again.
ReopenPreview.title: ReopenPreview

ReopenPreviewRequest.description: The members of the kept-distinct ruling to reopen, in any order.
ReopenPreviewRequest.title: ReopenPreviewRequest

ReopenResponse.description: What was reopened, and the warnings the apply raised along the way.
ReopenResponse.title: ReopenResponse

ReopenVersion.description:
The version a stateless caller reopens a ruling against: echo it
unchanged. `content_digest` covers the members and the sidecar holding the
ruling.
ReopenVersion.title: ReopenVersion

Reopened.description:
The ruling was reopened. `commit_sha` is `None` when its commit could not
be made (the write itself landed).
Reopened.title: Reopened

RevisionDetail.description:
A revision: a later Decision that reverses or refines an earlier one.
`later_id` is `None` when the dates do not order the pair; it never comes
from the model.
RevisionDetail.title: RevisionDetail

RunRequest.description:
The quote's token, echoed unchanged. A missing or null token is a
refusal the route answers (422 `run_refused`), not a validation error.
RunRequest.title: RunRequest

RunStatus.description:
A judging run as a poll sees it. The run's own result is a field here,
never the poll's HTTP status.
RunStatus.title: RunStatus

RuntimeReadiness.description:
The configured model runtime, as setup sees it.

`host` is the userinfo-redacted display host, the only form of it that may
be shown. `version` is the runtime's own version on `ollama` when it
answered, otherwise `None`. `download_url` is where to get Ollama, on the
`ollama` backend only.
RuntimeReadiness.title: RuntimeReadiness

SettingChange.description: One field that differs: what it is now and what it would become.
SettingChange.title: SettingChange

SetupReadiness.description:
Whether the workspace's models can run here. `ready` is true exactly
when the runtime answered and every required model is installed.
SetupReadiness.title: SetupReadiness

TierChangeApplyRequest.description:
The version the tier preview issued (echoed unchanged) and how long to
wait for the workspace lock; a client can shorten the wait only.
TierChangeApplyRequest.title: TierChangeApplyRequest

TierChangePreview.description:
Setting `type_name`'s tier to `tier`, or, with `tier` `None`, removing
its setting so the engine's default applies. `configured_tier` is the
setting now (`None` when there is none).
TierChangePreview.title: TierChangePreview

TierChangePreviewRequest.description:
The type whose tier to set, and the tier, or `null` to remove its
setting so the engine's default applies.
TierChangePreviewRequest.title: TierChangePreviewRequest

TierChangeResponse.description: What was changed, and the warnings the apply raised along the way.
TierChangeResponse.title: TierChangeResponse

TierChangeVersion.description:
The version a stateless caller changes a tier against: echo it unchanged.
`content_digest` covers the type, the tier asked for and `openkos.yaml`.
TierChangeVersion.title: TierChangeVersion

TierChanged.description:
The tier was set (`tier`) or its setting removed (`tier` `None`).
`commit_sha` is `None` when the commit could not be made (the write itself
landed).
TierChanged.title: TierChanged

TierDetail.description: A volatility decision: a suggested tier for one concept type.
TierDetail.title: TierDetail

TierPlan.description: Setting one concept type's volatility tier.
TierPlan.title: TierPlan

UnmergeApplyRequest.description:
The version the unmerge preview issued (echoed unchanged) and how long to
wait for the workspace lock; a client can shorten the wait only.
UnmergeApplyRequest.title: UnmergeApplyRequest

UnmergePreview.description:
What undoing a merge would do: every step in the order it runs, the
survivor's newer merges first, down to and including the named one.
UnmergePreview.title: UnmergePreview

UnmergePreviewRequest.description:
Which merge to undo: the survivor and the absorbed concept, and whether
the first step may discard an edit made to the survivor since its merge.
UnmergePreviewRequest.title: UnmergePreviewRequest

UnmergeResponse.description:
What the unmerge restored, and the warnings it raised along the way (for
example a commit that could not be made).
UnmergeResponse.title: UnmergeResponse

UnmergeStep.description:
One single-step unmerge of a plan: `absorbed_id` is restored beside
`survivor_id`, both to their bytes before that merge.
UnmergeStep.title: UnmergeStep

UnmergeVersion.description:
The version a stateless caller applies an unmerge against: echo it
unchanged. `content_digest` covers the ledger entries being reversed, every
file the steps restore, rewrite or recreate, and `discard_survivor_edits`,
so a changed bundle or an altered field is stale.
UnmergeVersion.title: UnmergeVersion

Unmerged.description:
The unmerge took effect: `restored_ids` are back beside the survivor, in
the order they were restored, each step committed on its own.
`commit_shas[i]` is `None` when that step's commit could not be made (the
restore itself still landed). `committed_confidential` is true when a
commit holds a concept explicitly marked confidential.
Unmerged.title: Unmerged

UnrelateApplyRequest.description:
The version the unrelate preview issued (echoed unchanged) and how long
to wait for the workspace lock; a client can shorten the wait only.
UnrelateApplyRequest.title: UnrelateApplyRequest

UnrelatePreview.description:
Removing the `relation_type` relation from `source_id` to `target_id`.
`withdraws_deprecation`: the target stops being marked superseded, because
nothing else supersedes it.
UnrelatePreview.title: UnrelatePreview

UnrelatePreviewRequest.description: The typed relation to remove: the source page, the type and the target.
UnrelatePreviewRequest.title: UnrelatePreviewRequest

UnrelateResponse.description: What was removed, and the warnings the apply raised along the way.
UnrelateResponse.title: UnrelateResponse

UnrelateVersion.description:
The version a stateless caller removes a relation against: echo it
unchanged. `content_digest` covers the edge and the pages the removal
rewrites.
UnrelateVersion.title: UnrelateVersion

Unrelated.description:
The relation was removed. `commit_sha` is `None` when its commit could
not be made (the write itself landed); `committed_confidential` is true when
the commit holds a concept explicitly marked confidential.
Unrelated.title: Unrelated
